title: company-tiltbox-merchlab
text:
company-tiltbox-merchlab

quals_summary:
Good fit for hosted_api self-serve pilot. Low technical ops, clear burst pattern, high cost sensitivity. Need to prove unit economics for catalog enrichment and p95 latency for Q&A.

notes:
Inbound from site chat widget 2026-02-09. Ecommerce SMB specialized in independent apparel & accessories (tiltbox brand marketplace). Wants quick self-serve integration for product Q&A + catalog enrichment. Primary asks: low ops, fast time-to-value, predictable per-month cost. "We need something that works out of the box — no infra ops for us" — founder. Very cost sensitive; will start with hosted API. Typical traffic: low steady browse + large burst windows for new drop emails (peak ~40-80 RPS for 5-10 minutes after launches). Concerned about API rate limits and per-token costs.

Technical constraints / asks (shorthand):
- Use-case: product Q&A on PDP (instant answers), catalog enrichment (auto-tags, short desc), search reranking for relevance.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 500ms for product Q&A (prefer <300ms); batch jobs for enrichment ok to be async.
- Throughput: bursts to 80 RPS during drops; average < 5 RPS off-peak.
- Cost sensitivity: high; looking for aggressive token/unit pricing or predictable monthly cap.
- Model prefs: smaller, fast open models preferred (7B-13B quantized); open to Redwood curated options.
- Fallbacks: on timeout, degrade to simple keyword search; graceful short answer from cached snippets.
- Security: require SSO for console (Okta), audit logs, minimal retention policy (30d) — legal asking for SOC2 evidence.

Sales timeline & context: founder signed up self-serve 2026-02-08, used free credits to run a quick catalog enrichment job (worked but cost spike surprised them). AE outreach 2026-02-10, intro call 2026-02-11 (ff_20260211_8a3b2c). SE joined to talk latency/quantization 2026-02-15. Customer wants a two-week hosted pilot with capped spend; will evaluate latency and drop-day behavior. "If the pilot keeps costs predictable and latency is ok we will onboard production for PDP answers and tag enrichment." - CTO.

Action items (short):
- Send quickstart repo + SDK snippets for JS + Python (Ava) — DONE 2026-02-12.
- Provide recommended model + quantization profile for catalog enrichment (Liam) — in progress.
- Propose pilot quota and pricing cap, include burst policy and rate-limit guidance (Ava) — scheduled 2026-02-19.
- Provide SOC2 evidence + security FAQ link for legal (support pack) — pending.

POC success criteria (customer):
- p95 Q&A latency < 500ms during 80 RPS bursts for 10 minutes.
- Catalog enrichment run completes for 25k SKUs at expected cost estimate.
- Clear billing cap/alerting to avoid unexpected charges.

Misc notes: founder keeps things terse; prefers Slack for comms. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/caching to lower unit cost. Possible expansion to Dedicated in 12-18 months if growth and SLO demands increase.
